capabilities.description: Governance-first skills and operating instructions for the AI an operator already uses, designed to improve context, continuity, control, and alignment with operator intent.
CoreOS™ v1.0 is a governance-first operating system delivered as an installable digital artifact. It does not require a Genie-us hosted runtime.
Organizations purchasing CoreOS™ for multiple people can contact Genie-us Software for volume licenses or volume pricing.
